evidence: Labeled Wallet and primarily modifies src/wallet/scriptpubkeyman.cpp to populate PSBT_GLOBAL_XPUB during PSBT filling.
rationale: Populating PSBT_GLOBAL_XPUB resolves concrete hardware wallet signing failures and removes third-party coordinator workarounds. Without this field, stateless signers such as the BitBox02 refuse to sign multisig PSBTs, and software like Specter had to inject global xpubs manually (#27583).
